parameters.name: state
parameters.description: PARKED, IN_MOVE, DOCKED or DEPARTED. Any other non-empty value is a 400 `invalid-state`.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Trailer kind. A non-empty value outside the enumeration is a 400 `invalid-state`.

parameters.name: visitId
parameters.description: Only the trailers attached to this visit.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-500, default 100. Anything else is a 400 `invalid-limit`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The opaque `nextCursor` of the previous page. A non-empty value this API did not issue is a 400 `invalid-cursor`.
